assessment_method: static source inspection and local dependency JSON/file-version inventory only
scope: Four additional automated real-browser visual harnesses outside the Python and Node built-in suites
not_run_reason: Every original harness hardcodes installed Microsoft Edge (channel=msedge). Phase 0 has no reproducibly pinned Edge runtime with OS-level network isolation. Page HTTP interception alone does not establish browser-wide egress denial. No browser was substituted or launched.

dependencies.metadata_source: Existing bundled package.json and playwright-core/browsers.json; no npm install/import

shared_requirements.network: Synthetic https://offline-wallet.test routes or about:blank; protocol automation uses browser pipes, no test HTTP server is required.
shared_requirements.outputs: Explicit positional output directory should be a new per-suite subdirectory under ignored .phase0/. Defaults are not used in Phase 0.

safety_limits: Original page.route handlers intercept page HTTP but do not provide OS-level network isolation for browser background traffic.
Service workers are not explicitly blocked and WebSocket routing is not guarded by the harnesses; current inspected frontend has no service-worker/WebSocket usage.
The baseline Node preload intentionally denies child processes. It must not be globally relaxed merely to run these harnesses.
A future dedicated stage must use a trusted, pinned Edge/runtime image and --network none (or equivalent), copy only allowlisted source/assets, provide no credentials, and restrict output paths.
Keep original harnesses byte-identical. Do not silently switch channel=msedge to Chromium or count historical screenshots as new passed tests.

page_routes: synthetic /api/ai/modes; only in-memory enabled flag changes
suites.route_limit: Matches pathname without validating origin/method; unexpected pathname throws. There is no route.continue, but browser-wide traffic is outside this handler.
fixture_notes: rescue.trigger_roe_pct=-50 is stale relative to shared runtime threshold -40; original fixture preserved.

page_routes: All page HTTP aborted; page.setContent HTML; injected in-memory api function
fixture_notes: MAINNET is only a synthetic displayed label; no signing client or backend exists in this harness.

suites.name: ui_position_actions_visual_audit.cjs
suites.scope: REDUCE/AVERAGE proposals, eight factors, translations, privacy, fake confirmed reduce, explicit HOLD resume/cancel, overflow and >=52px controls
suites.route_limit: Origin/method allowlist; other origins abort and unexpected local paths fail assertions. Dialogs are synthetic browser confirms.
fixture_notes: Supporting trader limits entry_pct=1/max_leverage=20 are stale relative to current shared entry policy 10/40; position-action target policy -40 is current.

suites.scope: Actual index/static scripts, #ai-position deep link, delayed dashboard, all six tabs, chart selections, header/navigation overflow and zero mutations
assets: Actual index.html and local static module/style/image assets including lazy ai-review.js

fixture_notes: Requires index build 20260906-11; no fixture or application build was altered in Phase 0.
